package_kind: pilot_triage (NOT deployable alpha; power-insufficient by design)
alpha_vector_note: Deliberately empty. This is a <=50-doc power-honest pilot; per pre-registration NO portfolio/alpha_vector is emitted and NO gate claim is permitted. A deployable score requires the Phase-A full-panel canonical screen (see alpha_validation.json scale_up_design).

factor_specs.formula: agent rubric score of linguistic complexity of annual-report '경영진단 및 분석의견' excerpt (2800 chars post-boilerplate)
factor_specs.lag_rule: rcept_dt basis; forward window = month AFTER rcept month, 12M
factor_specs.neutralization: Size-controlled (partial Spearman); confirmed NOT a size proxy
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Li (2008) JAE — managers obfuscate bad news with complex prose; higher MD&A complexity predicts lower subsequent performance. Distinct from disclosure-metadata (size proxy, killed WT-005).
factor_specs.redundancy_cluster_id: text_readability (novel material axis; no existing KR factor overlaps)

factor_specs.economic_rationale: PRE-REGISTERED sign POSITIVE; realized NEGATIVE (overoptimism-reversal). Secondary lead — flip sign in scale-up.

diagnostics.canonical_null_reason: Pilot is a cross-sectional rank-correlation triage on 45 docs spanning 2015-2023, NOT a monthly-rebalanced canonical top-N screen. canonical_screen_bt deferred to Phase-A scale-up (prereg forbids gate claim). IC->PORT_t transition wall explicitly unaddressed.

selection_objective_note: canonical_port_t is the intended graduation authority but is null here (pilot did not run canonical_screen_bt). Pilot selection among axes used pre-registered directional rule on fwd12m_excess rank correlation.

Subjective complexity scorer -> scale-up must use OBJECTIVE readability (sentence length / Fog / table-density).
